title: Noble Dark Ukrainian Chocolate Stir Fry
description: A romantic Ukrainian dish featuring dark chocolate and stir-fry, with a peppery and silky texture, perfect for a special occasion. This dish combines the richness of dark chocolate with the savory flavors of Ukrainian cuisine.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the dark chocolate and stir until melted and well combined.
Add the heavy cream and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
